name: merge-duplicate-contacts
notion_automation: NOT YET WIRED — a Notion DB automation on Contacts ("Duplicate of edited") must POST to trigger.webhook_url. Notion does not expose automations via API, so this is a manual step in the Notion UI.
description: Notion Contacts: Duplicate of set by a person -> merge the source into the target, but ONLY when identity is corroborated (equivalent names or the same LinkedIn profile; differing LinkedIn URLs are a hard decline). Fills empty target fields, ORs checkboxes, UNIONS every multi-value property, never copies the Duplicate of / Possible duplicate relations, and never deletes anything — the source is left in place with a comment saying what was copied. Replaces the Contact Merger Notion Custom Agent.
